title: Eidolons Eval Scorecard (matrix arm result)
description: Written by `eidolons eval swe --matrix <arms.json>` to evals/results/<UTC-date>-<suite>-<label>.scorecard.json, one file per arm (--no-store opts out). A committed, diffable record consumed by `eidolons eval baseline`. Smoke scorecards (harness.smoke:true) are plumbing-validation only — they prove the orchestration, not model capability. See evals/results/README.md.

suite.description: Suite identifier (the suite file's basename without .yaml), e.g. "swe-suite" or "kupo-keep-suite".

resolved.description: true iff at least one of the k runs reached final=passed.

passes.description: Number of the k runs that reached final=passed.

attempts.description: k — the number of independent runs attempted for this task.

token_usage.description: Optional token usage for this task across all k attempts. Omit if not captured.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens across all attempts.

output_tokens.description: Total output tokens across all attempts.

cache_creation_tokens.description: Total cache creation tokens (prompt caching writes).

cache_read_tokens.description: Total cache read tokens (prompt caching hits).

estimated_cost_usd.description: Optional estimated cost in USD for this task. Calculated using pricing_source.

pass_k_rate.description: Fraction of tasks resolved in ALL k runs (pass^k).

smoke.description: true iff this arm ran under --smoke (gold_fix reference, no model) — a plumbing-validation run, never a capability claim.

token_usage.description: Optional aggregate token usage for the entire arm run. Omit if not captured.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens across all tasks and attempts.

output_tokens.description: Total output tokens across all tasks and attempts.

cache_creation_tokens.description: Total cache creation tokens (prompt caching writes).

cache_read_tokens.description: Total cache read tokens (prompt caching hits).

estimated_cost_usd.description: Optional estimated total cost in USD for the arm run. Calculated using pricing_source.

pricing_source.description: Identifies the pricing data used to calculate estimated_cost_usd. Required when estimated_cost_usd is present.

file.description: Path to the pricing file used, e.g. 'roster/pricing.yaml'.

schema_version.description: Schema version of the pricing file.

as_of.description: Date the pricing was verified (ISO 8601 date, e.g. '2026-09-25').
